question: Different animal in Bhuj, Kutch, Gujarat: an injured community kitten needs low-cost treatment. Is there a government veterinary hospital I can take her to? Give an address or published contact, without assuming it is free.
expected: Reset city/species; safe kitten handling and real local public veterinary option; label office referral correctly and no unsupported free-care promise.
answer:
If the kitten is bleeding, apply gentle continuous pressure with a clean cloth if she allows it; keep her warm, quiet and in a secure box/carrier for transport.

**Government Veterinary Polyclinic (Animal Husbandry Department)**  
Opposite Reliance Mall, Mundra Road, Bhuj, Kachchh, Gujarat 370001.  
**Published phone:** 02832-230910.  

This is an Animal Husbandry Department facility; please call first to confirm they can examine a kitten today and ask about charges—government treatment may be lower-cost, but it is not necessarily free. ([scribd.com](https://www.scribd.com/document/1076998416/GEMC-511687796873698-27012025?utm_source=openai))
